crossRefs.note: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.
One said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, “How long will it be to the end of these…
I heard, but I didn’t understand. Then I said, “My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?”
As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be?…
As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,
“Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?”
Peter seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”
Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”
Therefore when they had come together, they asked him, “Lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel?”
He said to them, “It isn’t for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.
“But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.

Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
But when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”

parallels.note: “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?”

translations.web: They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”
translations.bsb: “Teacher,” they asked, “when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to take place?”
translations.kjv: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?
translations.asv: And they asked him, saying, Teacher, when therefore shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when these things are about to come to pass?
